title: Design: Convert to No Charge is not offered without See Financial Data
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user with Work Orders — Create & Edit but without See Financial Data.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow2-03-1c-convert-to-no-charge-no-permission.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu in the header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu has no "Convert to No Charge".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N2: “If the user does not have 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data', the Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable and Change category actions are not shown in the menu and the checkbox is not shown in the New Work Order dialog, as Add Work Order Fee / Discount is not offered.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
